_comment: Maxim v1.3.2 — declarative MCP server registry. 9 servers / 95 tools total (verified via server.tool() grep). v1.2.0.1 added mxm-commands (+2 tools cross-surface dispatcher). v1.2.1.0 added mxm-notebooklm (+38 tools per ADR-018 three-layer external-tool pattern). v1.3.2 surface-claims-drift correction: prior descriptions undercounted behavioral/context/memory/portfolio by 2 tools each. v1.1.0.3 (2026-04-27): each server spawns through mcp/_shared/spawn-with-deps.mjs which synchronously installs missing node_modules before importing the actual server.js, collapsing post-upgrade install flow from 2 restarts to 1 (BUG-007 follow-up).

mxm-portfolio.description: Portfolio metrics, project state, sync_portfolio across 21+ projects (9 tools)

mxm-context.description: Project context + design refs + drift detection (13 classes). 15 tools (v1.0.0: absorbed design, added watch_run/watch_report/watch_configure)

mxm-catalog.description: Agent + office + skill + command catalog. 9 tools (v1.0.0: merged from dispatch + skills)

mxm-compliance.description: 14 compliance frameworks (GDPR, PIPEDA, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOC2, UAE-PDPL, CASL, FINTRAC, EU AI Act, ISO 27001/13485/14971, NIST CSF, WCAG). 5 tools

mxm-behavioral.description: 86 frameworks (Fogg, COM-B, EAST, Hook, Cialdini, JTBD, AIDA, Nudge Theory, Prospect Theory, SDT, SCARF + 75 more). 7 tools

mxm-memory.description: Session history, decision log, memory search/store across project boundaries. 6 tools

mxm-voice.description: Voice-driven executive office routing. Wraps mbailey/voicemode for STT (Whisper) + TTS (Kokoro). Requires VoiceMode plugin installed. 4 tools

mxm-commands.description: Slash-command dispatcher — exposes all 50 /mxm-* commands as MCP tools. Closes command-parity gap for Claude Desktop / Web. 2 tools (mxm_command, list_commands). Added v1.2.0.1.

mxm-notebooklm.description: NotebookLM research synthesis — wraps teng-lin/notebooklm-py (MIT). 38 tools across notebook/source/chat/research/generate/artifact/auth/profile. Free-tier per ADR-018. Operator must install: pip install "notebooklm-py[browser]" && playwright install chromium && notebooklm login. Added v1.2.1.0.
